storage_extensions.usage: MANDATORY — the iter_2 implementation did NOT use this extension and scan_mi stayed at 24ms. This iter_3 implementation MUST mmap codes.bin as uint16_t* prefix_codes and use it as the FIRST filter in the CSR scan loop (before reading mi.movie_id). At program start, resolve japan_code and usa_code once via a linear scan of (dict.offsets, dict.data): for i in [0..19351), if (dict.offsets[i+1]-dict.offsets[i]==5 && memcmp(dict.data+dict.offsets[i],"Japan",5)==0) japan_code=i+1; if (==3 && memcmp(...,"USA",3)==0) usa_code=i+1. Dict is 1-based per registry; code==0 means no usable prefix. The CSR scan inner-loop MUST follow the exact filter_order below.

data_structures.dim_scalars: int32 ids for rt_actress, it_rd, cc_us, g_f; uint16 japan_code, usa_code resolved from prefix_dict at startup
data_structures.prefix_codes: mmap uint16_t* (29MB total file); accessed strided-sequentially in CSR-row order; first filter in CSR inner loop

parallelism.morsel_unit: Y/P bitset builds: parallel for over rows, atomic OR into bitset words. CSR scan: parallel for over k in [lo,hi) static schedule(8192) — larger morsel because per-iter work is now ~3 reads + branch (most rows skip immediately on prefix code). Main scan: parallel for over T static schedule(64). Per-thread local_T vectors, merged after the CSR scan.

like_strategies.method: Step 1 (once, at startup): resolve japan_code and usa_code by linear scan of prefix_dict (dict.offsets uint64_t[19352], dict.data raw bytes, 1-based ids). Step 2 (per CSR row, FIRST CHECK): code = prefix_codes[r]; if code != japan_code && code != usa_code: continue — single uint16 compare, no mi_mid/mi_info read. Step 3 (only for prefix survivors): mv = mi_mid[r]; if !Y[mv] continue. Step 4: read mi_info bytes; the prefix tells us which family — if code==japan_code, suffix starts after position 6 ('Japan:'); if code==usa_code, suffix starts after position 4 ('USA:'). Verify memmem('200', 3) in that suffix. The Japan:/USA: prefix string compare is no longer needed since the code already proved it.
length-pruned memmem during P_fused_bitset build (one-time, parallel).

scan_mi_csr_filter_order: 1. k iterates [lo, hi) where lo=mit_off[it_rd], hi=mit_off[it_rd+1]
2. r = mit_row[k]  // sequential read into mit_row (32MB total)
3. code = prefix_codes[r]  // STRIDED-SEQ read into 29MB; FIRST FILTER
4. if (code != japan_code && code != usa_code) continue  // skips ~99% of rows here
5. mv = mi_mid[r]  // only reached by ~80K-160K rows; random into 58MB but rare
8. s = mi_info_off_ptr[r]; e = mi_info_off_ptr[r+1]  // only for prefix+year survivors
11. if (memmem(mi_info_dat_ptr + s + prefix_len, (e - s) - prefix_len, "200", 3) == nullptr) continue
main_scan_filter_order: 1. mc range walk for mv: require any cn_country_code[company_id-1]==cc_us; break on first hit
c. pid = ci.person_id; require P_and_an bit set (single L2-resident bit test)
d. require ci.note voice-set (varlen, only for rare survivors)
e. update local MIN(name) and (once per movie) MIN(title)
optimization_notes: Iter_2 plan said to use prefix_dict but the generated code (lines 314-355 of iter_2/q19c.cpp) never read codes.bin — it did the same Y→varlen flow as iter_1, so scan_mi stayed at 24ms. Iter_3 strategy: Category A (filter reordering) + Category E (use existing storage extension). Two changes: (1) MANDATORY use of column_versions/movie_info.info.prefix_dict/codes.bin — mmap it as const uint16_t* prefix_codes. (2) Reorder the CSR inner loop so prefix_codes[r] is checked FIRST, BEFORE mi_mid[r]. Rationale: prefix_codes is 16MB strided-sequential (bandwidth-bound, ~2-3ms for 8M reads on 12 threads); mi_mid[r] is 58MB random — but if we filter on code first, ~99% of rows never read mi_mid at all. Y bitset check moves to position 3, only hit by ~80K-160K survivors. Resolve japan_code and usa_code once at startup by linear-scanning the 19351-entry dict (1-based ids per registry). For survivors, the prefix length is known (6 for Japan:, 4 for USA:), so we skip the string prefix re-compare and go directly to memmem('200', tail). Expected: scan_mi 24ms → 8-12ms; total 63ms → ~45-50ms. Year threshold 2000 and the four voice-note strings are preserved verbatim.
